result:
Summary: The exact match (EM) results for DRAGIN on HotpotQA, according to the provided sources, show that the DRAGIN model achieved an EM of 0.314 for the L13B version and 0.288 for the V13B version. The EM results for the Llama2-13b-chat model without RAG (wo-RAG) was 0.187, while with different RAG methods, the EM ranged from 0.217 to 0.270. The highest EM score among these was achieved by the FS-RAG method with 0.270.
